question: Hello Oda-san! When Luffy was talking about the end of his dream, Caribou was nearby inside a barrel! Does this mean that Caribou also heard the end of Luffy's dream?
answer: So, a lot of people were bothered by this, but please look at the previous page. Even when they spoke in a loud voice, he can only barely hear what they say. It didn't reach inside the barrel, so it's okay. It was only the Straw Hat Pirates who heard the end of Luffy's dream!
name: Sena
